findings.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(fee_paise - (CASE WHEN method = 'upi' THEN CAST(ROUND(CAST(amount_paise AS DECIMAL(38,6)) * CAST('2.00' AS DECIMAL(12,6)) / 100, 0) AS BIGINT) WHEN method = 'card' THEN CAST(ROUND(CAST(amount_paise AS DECIMAL(38,6)) * CAST('2.00' AS DECIMAL(12,6)) / 100, 0) AS BIGINT) WHEN method = 'netbanking' THEN CAST(ROUND(CAST(amount_paise AS DECIMAL(38,6)) * CAST('2.00' AS DECIMAL(12,6)) / 100, 0) AS BIGINT) WHEN method = 'wallet' THEN CAST(ROUND(CAST(amount_paise AS DECIMAL(38,6)) * CAST('2.00' AS DECIMAL(12,6)) / 100, 0) AS BIGINT) WHEN method = 'emi' THEN CAST(ROUND(CAST(amount_paise AS DECIMAL(38,6)) * CAST('2.00' AS DECIMAL(12,6)) / 100, 0) AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END)), 0) FROM events WHERE type = 'payment_captured' AND occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-03-23' AND '2026-03-29'

findings.title: Captured in the window, settles after it
findings.note: ordinary T+2 timing, not a loss
findings.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_paise), 0) FROM postings WHERE account = 'gateway_receivable' AND occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-03-30' AND '2026-04-05'

findings.title: Held back because the bank was shut
findings.note: T+2 fell on a non-banking day (2026-04-04, 2026-04-05); late, not lost
findings.sql: WITH delayed AS ( SELECT p.ref AS payment_id, p.amount_paise FROM postings p JOIN calendar c ON c.d = p.occurred_at WHERE p.account = 'gateway_receivable' AND p.event_type = 'payment_captured' AND p.occurred_at BETWEEN '2026-03-30' AND '2026-04-05' AND c.t2_naive <= '2026-04-05' AND c.t2_actual > '2026-04-05') SELECT COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_paise) FROM delayed), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_paise) FROM events WHERE type = 'route_transfer' AND counterparty IN (SELECT payment_id FROM delayed)), 0)
